targetEnvironment: Netlify Static Web Hosting vs. Node.js Express Cloud Run

issueSummary.problem: Registration, Login, and API calls fail after Netlify deployment
issueSummary.primaryRootCause: Netlify static CDN hosting serves static HTML/JS/CSS assets without running the Node.js Express backend process ('server.ts'). All relative HTTP fetch calls to '/api/*' return 404 or index.html SPA fallbacks.

VITE_API_BASE_URL.impact: On Netlify, relative fetches hit the Netlify static CDN edge instead of an external backend API URL.

DATABASE_URL.impact: PostgreSQL connection string cannot be accessed directly by browser frontend.

forensicApiTable.why: Express server ('server.ts') is not running on Netlify CDN; fetch returns 404 or HTML fallback causing JSON parsing error.
No backend server to handle user creation, password hashing (bcrypt), or DB record creation.
JWT token verification requires backend secret key validation on Express.
Refresh token secret validation relies on server process.
Requires server-side bcrypt hashing and database update.
Diagnostic trace endpoint is executed by Node.js process.
Sync endpoint writes to data/*.json or PostgreSQL; unserved on static CDN.
12-month financial forecasting engine runs inside Node.js backend.
Disaster recovery, backups, and integrity tests require Express server.
Chart of accounts ledger queries backend database.
Journal voucher verification and ledger postings require backend.
Sales pipeline and plot booking APIs require server handlers.
RBAC security enforcement endpoints require active Express backend.
Purge and restore operations execute filesystem/database tasks.
Health metrics check requires active Node server process.

optionA.title: OPTION A: Client-Side Standalone Hybrid (Frontend-Only)
optionA.description: Empower the app to operate in pure client-side mode using browser localStorage / IndexedDB for user authentication, session state, and repository persistence when API endpoints are unreachable.
implementationSteps: 1. Update AuthContext.tsx to fall back to client-side localStorage authentication and mock JWT generation when /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register fetch fails with 404 or network error.
2. Update dbService.ts to use client-side storage persistence without failing on missing backend endpoints.
3. Configure client-side fallback handlers for demo roles so all 11 executive demo personas work instantly on static Netlify.

optionB.title: OPTION B: Separate Express Backend Deployment (Cloud Run / Railway / Render + Netlify Rewrites)
optionB.description: Deploy the existing Express server ('server.ts') to Cloud Run, Render, or Railway, and configure Netlify redirects ('_redirects') to proxy '/api/*' requests to the deployed backend URL.
implementationSteps: 1. Deploy server.ts to Cloud Run or Render.
2. Add public/_redirects file to Netlify build: '/api/* https://your-backend.run.app/api/:splat 200'
3. Define environment variable VITE_API_BASE_URL on Netlify.

optionC.title: OPTION C: Netlify Serverless Functions or Supabase Migration
optionC.description: Migrate Express routes to Netlify Serverless Functions using serverless-http or integrate Supabase Auth & PostgreSQL.
implementationSteps: 1. Package server.ts into netlify/functions/api.ts using serverless-http.
2. Configure netlify.toml to route /api/* to the serverless function.
3. Connect to Supabase or hosted PostgreSQL database.
